item.title: 在《如何在股票中赚钱》一书中，奥尼尔将“M”（市场方向）视为决定性的过滤器：强有力
item.description:
在《如何在股票中赚钱》一书中，奥尼尔将“M”（市场方向）视为决定性的过滤器：强有力的选股无法克服总体市场的下跌。

当整体市场趋势下跌时，大约四分之三的股票将随着大盘平均水平下跌，即使这些股票具有强劲的基本面。

CANSLIM中的M非常重要！

In How to Make Money in Stocks, O'Neil treated the "M" (Market direction) as a decisive filter: strong stock selection cannot overcome a falling general market.

Roughly three out of four stocks will fall along with the broader market averages when the overall market trend is down, even if those stocks have strong fundamentals.

The M in CANSLIM is very important!

item.title: @ThePupOfWallSt 我猜你从未收到过那个人的回复 $MBLY 创下 2026 年 4 月以来的最低收
item.description:
@ThePupOfWallSt

我猜你从未收到过那个人的回复

$MBLY 创下 2026 年 4 月以来的最低收盘价，较该推文交易下跌 54%。差不多两年后，他们仍然在包袱里。

@ThePupOfWallSt

I guess you never heard back from that guy

$MBLY with its lowest closing since April 2026 and down 54% from that tweet exchange. They are still bag holding almost 2 years later.

@ThePupOfWallSt

很明显，这里的包夹就是你和你的朋友 $MBLY

没关系。它也会上升，当它上升时，你会在山顶尖叫，在这些年月里，你是多么“聪明”地坚持和 DCA。

与此同时，我和其他许多人都会捕捉到多笔 2 倍至 5 倍的交易，这些交易实际上是看涨的并且正在走高。

可悲的是，今年有很多这样的事情，而 MBLY 却做了《JACK SHIT》。

太多了，无法一一列举，但你见过 $APP 吗？可能不会。对横盘的股票垂涎欲滴。希望不是一种策略。

It’s become apparent the bag holder here is you and your friend $MBLY

It’s fine. It too will rise and when it does, you’ll scream from the mountaintops how “smart” you were to bag hold and DCA all those months and years.

Meanwhile, I and many others will have caught multiple 2x-5x trades that are ACTUALLY bullish and moving higher.

Sad part is, there have been many of those this year while MBLY has done JACK SHIT.

Too many to list but have you seen $APP? Probably not. Stuck salivating over a sideways stock. Hope is not a strategy.
